## Appearance

Davy is a handsome boy with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He has roguish, dancing hazel eyes, a positive snub nose, and a single dimple in one of his cheeks. Over time, he has grown by an inch.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a mischievous, heedless, and forgetful boy who possesses an energetic nature and a lively curiosity. He frequently asks inquisitive questions and acts with more zeal than discretion. His ambitions include becoming a storekeeper to have plenty of candy, living to be a hundred years old, and having fun by scaring people or welcoming loved ones home with a bonfire.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +5 more_

## History

Davy Keith lost his father as a baby, grew up without a proper upbringing, and lived with a sick mother who was unable to bake cakes. He was brought to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), where his unruly and mischievous nature quickly caused trouble for the household. Early on, he hid [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse and lied about her disappearance, but he tearfully repented after learning that deceit hurt [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Despite his antics, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grew fond of him as they worked to manage his behavior. Davy and Dora's stay became permanent after word arrived that their uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), had died and left money in trust for them. He frequently turned to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for guidance and comfort, including confessing his guilt to her after coercing [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and lying to Mrs. Lynde. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned home from college during a later break, Davy excitedly shared his thoughts on marriage, and he subsequently broke the news to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was critically ill with typhoid fever.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), +24 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> "I never s’posed there was so many. I’m sorry it’s wrong to tell whop . . . falsehoods, ’cause it’s awful handy, but since it is I’m never going to tell any more. What are you going to do to me for telling them this time? I want to know."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P60](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0060)

> “But I tell you there is,” persisted Davy. “It was in that question Marilla taught me last Sunday. ‘Why should we love God?’ It says, ‘Because He makes preserves, and redeems us.’ Preserves is just a holy way of saying jam.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P27](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0027)

> "if Marilla’ll hold them by the legs, ’cause I guess it’d take both my hands to manage the axe. It’s awful jolly fun to see them hopping about after their heads are cut off."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P21](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0021)

> "If I’m as good as good can be all day tomorrow will you let me be just as bad as I like all the next day?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P36](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) serves as a authority figure alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), while also acting as Davy's teacher and friend. Davy holds fond affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though he frequently causes trouble that she must manage, such as hiding a toad in Marilla's bed or locking his sister in a toolhouse. When Davy realizes his deceit hurts Anne's feelings, he shows genuine remorse, leading her to forgive his pranks even while disciplining him.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +20 more_

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister. Davy's mischievous nature often targets her, including an incident where he made her fall into a pigpen and another where he locked her in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and lied about her whereabouts, causing widespread alarm.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +19 more_

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Davy's guardian who maintains authority and enforces discipline over him at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy tests her boundaries by committing various pranks, such as putting a toad in her bed and skipping his prayers to test her warnings, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintains a fond affection for him despite the difficulties his antics cause.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +11 more_

- Serves under — guardian who gives orders and enforces discipline  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>

### [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--milty-boulter.md)

Davy and [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) share a friendly relationship centered on going fishing together. They also engage in a personal rivalry, competing against each other over their height.
